names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/14259.html` link carries in its `title` and as that page's heading, «Валентин (Лукьянов), иеромонах, прмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off; the surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays. The day's own line gives only «Прмч. Валентина (1940).» `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write, and no folder in the corpus held any form of this forename.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст.: «Прмч. Валентина (1940).» His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Прмч. Валентина (1940).»

attestations.note: **The line is all there is.** Name page 14259 is a heading, the grade and two days, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 19 мая», and nothing else; the 26 января is the synaxis of the new martyrs, a company's feast and not a second day of his own. The line's rank is «Прмч.», which BRIEF-RUSSIAN §6 reads as `venerable-martyr`, and the name page adds «иеромонах», which gives the `hieromonk` type and the office — `Hieromonk` being a word the four locale packs carry, as `macarius-telegin` already shows. He is the only entry of 1940 on this day. azbyka.ru was not read.
